Where public Azure excels and breaks
Azure Arc as control plane projection

takeaways: Public cloud, hybrid and multi-cloud are operating model decisions with security, cost and organizational debt attached, not provider preferences.
Hybrid works as distributed compute with centralized control, and Azure Arc extends Azure Resource Manager governance, policy and inventory to resources outside Azure.
Score regulatory pressure, latency sensitivity, cost predictability, cloud maturity and change velocity to decide between public-first, hybrid-first or bounded multi-cloud.
hook: Most enterprises never chose public cloud, hybrid or multi-cloud; their architecture accumulated one exception at a time. This episode is for IT leaders and architects running Microsoft environments who need to decide where workloads belong. Learn where Azure excels, why hybrid needs a single control plane like Azure Arc, and a five-axis framework to choose deliberately.
